requests.title: Successful recovery is converted to failure
requests.evidence: raise SystemExit(main()) is inside try whose except BaseException also catches SystemExit(0). Successful main writes the terminal trio and recovery.completed, prints RECOVERED_METADATA_ONLY, then exception path prints RECOVERY_INCOMPLETE and exits 1.
requests.change: Keep success SystemExit outside the try/except or catch Exception; test success and failure entrypoint dispatch without running recovery/gate.

requests.title: Some preserved original files are not pinned to the independently observed snapshot
requests.evidence: copy-map and independent invocation files are admitted through initial raw_at and self-reported map pins. A changed PF/admission.head.invocation.json, identical changed AUTH copy and updated copy-map can pass while admission.actual_Git_records remains the original record. No equality check binds that independent invocation to the original record.
requests.change: Consume boundary_review.disk_assessment via its immutable pin and require exact fixed SHA/bytes and membership of PF32/AUTH34; then run current copy-map and semantic checks. Add a pure control for changed invocation plus revised map.

requests.title: Execution-root absence is not rechecked after the long gate
requests.evidence: Post-gate checks cover PF/AUTH and missing seal trio only. Gate load_scope observes E/export near its beginning and intentionally permits L. The recovery may seal after an execution root appears or the supplied process observation becomes stale.
requests.change: Immediately before first terminal write recheck all E/L/export using bounded non-reparse paths and lexists; revalidate process observation age. Add pure controls for a root appearing during gate and stale observation after gate.
